description: This file is a minified or concatenated JavaScript source file defining the jGrowl plugin, a notification system built on jQuery for unobtrusive user alerts. It includes plugin initialization, default settings, notification creation, rendering logic, update cycles, and shutdown procedures, with extensive comments describing version history, usage, and features.

methods.name: jGrowl
methods.description: Creates a global notification container and posts notifications to it.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the notification container, creates the notification wrapper, and sets up periodic update.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Removes the notification container and stops periodic updates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and queues a new notification message with specified options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a notification element in the DOM with associated event handling and styles.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Checks for expired notifications and renders new notifications if available.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Triggers the closure of all notifications in the container.
